caseNameFull: Griffin v. Bowersox, Acting Superintendent, Potosi Correctional Center
judges: Application, Execution, Ginsburg, Grant, Stay, Stevens

opinions.text:
C. A. 8th Cir. Application for stay of execution of sentence of death, presented to Justice Thomas, and by him referred to the Court, denied. Certiorari denied.

Justice Stevens, Justice Ginsburg, and Justice Breyer would grant the application for stay of execution.
